info.description: REST API for the Nicoflow productivity platform
info.title: Nicoflow API

get.description: Returns all AI conversation sessions for the authenticated user

post.description: Creates a new AI conversation session for the authenticated user

delete.description: Deletes an AI conversation session owned by the authenticated user

get.description: Returns all messages in the specified AI conversation session

post.description: Sends a message in an AI conversation session and returns the assistant reply

get.description: Returns all areas belonging to the authenticated user

post.description: Creates a new area for the authenticated user

put.description: Updates the name of an area owned by the authenticated user

delete.description: Deletes an area owned by the authenticated user

post.description: Returns a pre-signed S3 URL to download a file attachment
Returns a pre-signed S3 URL to upload a file attachment
Authenticates a user and returns access + refresh tokens
Logs out the current user (client should discard tokens)
Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access token (single-use rotation)
Creates a new user account with email and password

get.description: Returns a Lemon Squeezy checkout URL to upgrade to PRO
Returns a Lemon Squeezy customer portal URL to manage subscription

post.description: Receives and processes Lemon Squeezy webhook events. Idempotent — duplicate events are ignored.

get.description: Returns 200 if the server is running
Returns all unscheduled tasks (project_id IS NULL) for the authenticated user

post.description: Quickly captures a task title into the inbox (no project, no scheduling)
Parses a natural language task description into structured task fields. Requires PRO plan.

get.description: Returns all projects belonging to the authenticated user

post.description: Creates a new project for the authenticated user, optionally under an area

put.description: Updates a project owned by the authenticated user

delete.description: Deletes a project owned by the authenticated user

get.description: Returns all tasks belonging to the authenticated user

post.description: Creates a new task for the authenticated user

put.description: Updates a task owned by the authenticated user

delete.description: Deletes a task owned by the authenticated user

get.description: Returns all subtasks for the specified task

post.description: Creates a new subtask under the specified task

put.description: Updates the title or done state of a subtask

delete.description: Deletes a subtask from the specified task

get.description: Returns tasks grouped by scheduled date for the authenticated user
Returns the current subscription plan for the authenticated user
Upgrades the HTTP connection to a WebSocket for real-time updates. Not yet implemented.
